title: Lahore, Punjab — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lahore, Punjab: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lahore is a city in Punjab with a population of 12,642,000. The cultural capital of Pakistan, known for its Mughal architecture, vibrant food scene, and as the heart of Punjab province. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
